questions.question: Describe the automation framework you built at Apex Systems. What were its BDD and data-driven components, and how did you organize it for maintainability?
How have you used Java, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and the Page Object Model to automate acceptance or regression testing?
Walk me through how you would test a Dynamics 365 ERP customization involving a new supply-chain workflow, custom entity, and integration with another system.
This role requires technical leadership of developers. Describe an occasion where you guided teammates, coordinated testing and development work, or influenced quality practices within a Scrum team.
How do you approach API testing for an integration? Please describe how you use Postman or REST Assured to validate HTTP methods, payloads, JSON/XML structures, error handling, and downstream data.
Tell me about your experience performing back-end data validation with SQL, JDBC, Oracle, or MySQL. How do you reconcile UI or API results with database records?

What quality gates would you recommend for a D365 development team before deploying changes to production, including code review, automated testing, regression testing, defect triage, and release validation?
Describe how you configured or used Jenkins, Git, Maven, and AWS EC2 to support continuous testing. How did test execution results get communicated to the team?
How do you work with product owners, developers, and nontechnical stakeholders when requirements are ambiguous or when a defect affects a planned release?

This position involves concurrent projects and an onsite hybrid schedule in Issaquah. How do you prioritize test and delivery work across multiple initiatives while maintaining quality and meeting sprint timelines?
